idea-plugin.name: oku
idea-plugin.description: Shows an oku page the way oku builds it: the kit's own renderer, beside the markdown, updated as you type, following the editor's scroll. Checks the page as it is typed, completes the JSON inside oku-* fences from oku's own schema, and resolves #f/ file references. A tree's index.html opens as the page it is the door to. Needs the oku tool installed (./ctl deploy in the oku repository); without it an oku page opens in the Markdown editor. Settings → Tools → oku.
